mapper.select:
SELECT n.notice_no ,n.notice_type ,FIND_CODENAME(n.notice_type) AS notice_type_name ,n.notice_date ,n.notice_title ,n.notice_content
FROM notice n join sub_cd s ON(n.notice_type = s.sub_cd)
WHERE n.class_id = #{classId} AND notice_type = 'F401'
ORDER BY n.notice_date DESC

SELECT n.notice_no ,n.notice_type ,FIND_CODENAME(n.notice_type) AS notice_type_name ,n.notice_date ,n.notice_title ,n.notice_content
FROM notice n join sub_cd s ON(n.notice_type = s.sub_cd)
WHERE n.class_id = #{classId} AND notice_type = 'F402'
ORDER BY n.notice_date DESC

SELECT n.notice_no ,n.notice_type ,n.notice_date ,s.sub_cd_nm AS notice_type_name ,n.notice_title ,n.notice_content
FROM notice n join sub_cd s ON(n.notice_type = s.sub_cd)
WHERE n.class_id = #{classId} AND notice_type = #{noticeType}
AND ROWNUM <= 5
AND ROWNUM <= 1
ORDER BY n.notice_date DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notice WHERE notice_type = 'F402' AND notice_date < ADD_MONTHS(sysdate,-1)
